svg.title: CloudKit Buddy comparison after Mac setup
svg.desc: On November 19, 2026, a Mac that had already completed setup returned an acquisition-creator response for each of the two flag settings examined. The experiment stopped at that preliminary response. It acquired zero sessions and requested no CloudKit data. A separate review of installed software examined readiness checks. Behavior before setup and the authorization outcome of a full session remain unverified.

g.text: How far did the Buddy comparison get?
Both flag settings returned a creator response.
It is the daemon’s initial response. The experiment stopped before asking for a session.
A separate review found readiness checks in the installed software. How a full session would
behave before setup, and what it could access, remain open questions.
Sources S16 and S18 · Retained experiment and separate installed-code review
